<subject>Clarification on [ORG_1]?</subject>
<body>
Antony,

[ORG_2], acting for the Department of Water Resources (DWR), will be issuing a tender for gas supply services. At this stage, we are considering a limited procurement and wish to establish a standard supply agreement. We would appreciate a brief update on the current status of the agreement between your firm and the DWR. If your Compliance or Corporate team has any queries, please reach out to Dale Fletcher at [ORG_2] directly on +44 7817 646361.

To alleviate any credit-related reservations, the department is finalising a full credit dossier, which will be shared with your office as soon as available.

Please don’t hesitate to get in touch.

Kind regards,  
Judith Dennis  
Contract Administration  
[ORG_2]  
+44 7817 646361  
</body>
